description: The environment variables the Azure DevOps record step (record-step.yml) hands to record-step.mjs, as Azure Pipelines would expand them for one fictional run. The local test runs the script with exactly these values, with RECORD_ENDPOINT_URL pointed at the local stub, and expects the stub to receive deployment.json. RECORD_STARTED_ON and RECORD_ENDPOINT_SCOPE show what Azure Pipelines does with a variable nobody defined: it leaves the macro as text, and the script treats that as not set. Fictional data only.

variables.RECORD_ENDPOINT_URL: set by the test to the local stub
